sermon.title: Fight For God - October 29, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: After worship and prayer for the Spirit, the message contrasts Saul and David. Saul was given a new heart but chose to please people, lost God’s presence and turned on David; David, despite his sin, repented and fought for God with his heart, his mouth and his love. The church must love God first, renew its heart and become a David church.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The service opens with a reading of 1 Corinthians 14:26 and a long worship set (lyrics as captioned). The message starts at about 25:50 with “10:6” (1 Samuel 10:6). He cites “Romans 12:12” for “do not be conformed to this world” (Romans 12:2), corrected in the reference.

faqs.question: What is edification?
faqs.answer: The building up of the body of Christ.

faqs.question: Did Samson have big muscles?
faqs.answer: He says no; he looked like a regular man, with strength from the Spirit of God.

faqs.question: What victory did Saul win early on?
faqs.answer: He led a successful attack against the Ammonites, he says, summarizing.

scriptures.text_nkjv: So it was, on the next day, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the camp in the morning watch, and killed Ammonites until the heat of the day. And it happened that those who survived were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.

faqs.question: Who were the volunteers?
faqs.answer: He volunteered Ryan and Mr. Dagel to pick between two pieces of fruit, one of them fake.

faqs.question: Do spiritual gifts matter more than obedience?
faqs.answer: He doesn’t care if you can talk in tongues or have the gift of healing; do you obey and serve the living God?

faqs.question: What song made Saul angry?
faqs.answer: Saul has slain his thousands and David his ten thousands.

faqs.question: Can I worship at home?
faqs.answer: Yes; open a Psalm or a Proverb, pray it and sing it.

faqs.question: What illustration does he use for the tongue?
faqs.answer: The wildfire smoke here in California.

faqs.question: What can we do when we mess up?
faqs.answer: Come to Christ; we have an advocate with the Father and can get forgiveness.

scriptures.text_nkjv: My little children, these things I write to you, so that you may not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.

faqs.question: What does the closing prayer call worship?
faqs.answer: A weapon in God’s hand to drive back the enemy and the avenger.
